title: Add LLM integration section in productivity tools and add HueHive
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Since mermaid diagram creation is a perfact usecase for LLMs adding a section for LLM integration make sense. HueHive is a tool to create and visualize mermaid diagrams with the help of ChatGPT. Please let me know if it is fine to add this or this should be added in some other section. 


## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

NA

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

PS: I am creater of HueHive diagrams tool.
author: kamalkishor1991

comments.author: sidharthv96

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment explicitly requests a code change with a specific suggestion — adding a new '### LLM integrations' headline and reformatting the entry under it.
